prompt: Painterly cinematic realism with Old-Master light, one warm grade, fine film grain. Medium wide shot. The wide wooden door in the side of the vast ark, its whole hull smeared pitch-black under a flat plank roof, stands half raised on its hinges above the earthen ramp, onlookers in silhouette at the foot of the ramp. Grey dusk, wind and the first heavy rain streaking across the black pitch. Final and awesome. The ark is one long, low, box-shaped wooden hull with straight sides of rough planks and flat square ends, the same low height from end to end. The ark has no mast, sail, prow, figurehead, funnel or smokestack, no smoke rising from it and no band along its waterline. The ancient Near East in the days of the flood: the great wooden ark, the open water, the mountains of Ararat and the empty new earth. No stone buildings, towers, churches, glass lanterns, modern clothing or roads. No text, no logos.
